name: gramity
description: Gramity — custodial DCA executor on TON mainnet. Conversational control via Mira; no funds flow through Mira.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Returns portfolio summary with frequency, amount_usdt, status, next_cycle, cycles_completed, total_invested_usdt, agent_wallet_balance_usdt, can_run_now, and masked withdrawal_address.

tools.name: create_strategy
tools.description: Update DCA strategy. Standard: min $10, daily/weekly/biweekly/monthly. Quick Start: min $2, intervals 10s/30s/60s, 2 cycles on mainnet. Use quick_mode=true to switch.

tools.name: pause_strategy
tools.description: Pause the active DCA strategy for a user.

tools.name: resume_strategy
tools.description: Resume a paused DCA strategy for a user.

tools.name: run_now
tools.description: Immediately execute one DCA cycle: Omniston swap → Tonstakers → STON.fi LP. Uses strategy amount by default. LP tokens go to locked withdrawal address.

tools.name: withdraw
tools.description: Send available USDT from agent wallet to user's locked withdrawal address. Cannot change the withdrawal address — it was locked during onboarding.

tools.name: update_frequency
tools.description: Change how often DCA cycles run. Does not change amount or strategy.

tools.name: update_amount
tools.description: Change the USDT amount per DCA cycle. Min $10. Does not affect frequency.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Returns last N completed DCA cycles with amounts and transaction links.
